product_family: IBM Cognos Analytics - enterprise business intelligence and data analytics platform with agentic AI, available in cloud-hosted (SaaS), on-premises, and containerized (Cloud Pak for Data) deployment models

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: IBM Cognos Analytics on Cloud expands compliance posture with availability of SOC 1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 2 Reports. These services were assessed throughout the period May 1, 2020 to October 31, 2020 with auditor PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP.

certifications.name: SOC 1 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: IBM Cognos Analytics on Cloud holds SOC 1 Type 2 certification, assessed May 1, 2020 to October 31, 2020 by PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: IBM has obtained business unit certifications for ISO 27001 (information security management system). IBM maintains ISO 27001 certifications by country and business unit.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 (Cloud Services)
certifications.proof_quote: IBM has obtained business unit certifications for ISO 27017 (information security for cloud services).

certifications.name: ISO 27018 (PII in Public Cloud)
certifications.proof_quote: IBM has obtained business unit certifications for ISO 27018 (information security for PII in public clouds).

certifications.name: ISO 27701 (Privacy Management)
certifications.proof_quote: IBM Cloud's PaaS and SaaS offerings have implemented a Privacy Information Management System (PIMS) under ISO/IEC 27701:2019.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: IBM provides GDPR process automation for Cognos Analytics. The IBM Cognos GDPR tool facilitates discovery and analysis of Cognos content for personal information and has capabilities to optionally delete or modify Cognos objects or outputs that contain personal and sensitive information.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: IBM Cloud supports HIPAA and provides BAA agreements. HIPAA-eligible services include Watson Studio, Watson Machine Learning, and Watson Knowledge Catalog in specific regions. IBM Cloud Pak for Data has HIPAA considerations documented, but Cognos Analytics is not explicitly listed as HIPAA-ready in publicly available documentation.

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO/IEC 42001 certification for IBM Cognos Analytics or IBM Cloud services found.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence of FedRAMP certification for IBM Cognos Analytics in public documentation.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence of PCI DSS certification for IBM Cognos Analytics in public documentation.

privacy.ai_training_note: Customer data is used for necessary processing within the tool. Data is not used to train IBM's AI models without explicit customer consent. IBM Cognos Analytics includes agentic AI capabilities (AI assistant, reporting agents) but does not train on customer data by default.
privacy.data_region: EU and US data residency options available; customers can select EU or US hosting in cloud deployment

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS/SSL (Transport Layer Security) configurable; can configure specific TLS versions and cipher suites

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Supported via AES-256 encryption on cloud platforms (Azure, IBM Cloud); database passwords encrypted when saved

security.name: FIPS mode
security.value: Can be enabled to use only FIPS 140-2 certified security modules; uses IBM Crypto for C and OpenSSL. Not enabled by default due to performance considerations.

security.name: Access control
security.value: Role-based access control (RBAC), fine-grained permissions, integration with external authentication (LDAP, Active Directory), granular administrative controls

security.name: Audit and governance
security.value: Centralized governance, audit trails, certified data models, compliance-ready reporting

security.name: Data handling
security.value: Data retention policies allow secure deletion upon customer request or at contract termination. Complies with GDPR and regional privacy laws.

products.name: Cognos Analytics Cloud Hosted
products.data_scope: Single-tenant cloud deployment on IBM Cloud data centers; SOC 2 Type 2 and SOC 1 Type 2 certified
products.notes: Managed by IBM; guaranteed uptime, automatic backups, dedicated IBM Cloud Ops; can access on-premises data via VPN

products.name: Cognos Analytics On-Premises
products.data_scope: Customer-hosted and managed; full control over data and infrastructure
products.notes: Ideal for organizations prioritizing data security and governance; customer responsible for security implementation

products.name: Cognos Analytics Cloud Pak for Data
products.data_scope: Fully containerized; deployable in any cloud (IBM Cloud, Azure, AWS, GCP) or on-premises
products.notes: Full Kubernetes support; flexible, scalable, cost-efficient; customer manages deployment security

products.name: Cognos Analytics AWS Marketplace
products.data_scope: Deployment via AWS Marketplace in AWS infrastructure
products.notes: Leverages AWS security and compliance controls

compare.pricing_model: Per-authorized-user SaaS subscription (cloud-hosted); Standard ($11.25/user/month) and Premium ($44.90/user/month); on-premises requires licensing; container deployment available
compare.data_residency: EU and US hosting options for cloud deployment; on-premises and container deployments allow full customer control of data location

flags: SOC 2 Type 2 certification is from 2020 (assessment period May-Oct 2020) - now 5+ years old and should be refreshed with current audit
Product-specific ISO 27001 certification not explicitly documented; corporate and business unit certifications exist but product applicability unclear

HIPAA eligibility unclear: IBM Cloud supports HIPAA with BAA, but Cognos Analytics not explicitly listed as HIPAA-ready; Cloud Pak for Data has HIPAA considerations but Cognos not specifically mentioned
Marketing claims 'compliance-ready reporting' and 'certified data models' but specific certifications not exhaustively documented across all deployment types (on-premises, containers)
Trust center and compliance pages mostly unavailable (403 Forbidden) for direct verification; information gathered from community posts and support pages
FIPS mode can be enabled but product is not FIPS-certified by default; some configuration files not encrypted with FIPS-certified providers
Vendor marketing emphasizes compliance and governance, but specific product certifications are less clearly delineated than corporate-level certifications
